source.description: Exact coordinate arrays and design metadata from the approved coordinate-locked master; baseline frames from saved authoring contracts.

design.markedInclusionRule: User review strokes are traced at their centrelines and add enclosed land to the named region; they do not remove already-owned land outside the enclosure.
design.westhavenAssignmentRule: Non-autumn land west of the Four Gates circle between Z 650 and 1100
design.manymouthAssignmentRule: Land south of the Four Gates circle from Z 1010 through the southern river reach

correction.scope: Ownership polygons only; original design metadata, coordinate frames and baseline storage retained. Original master and original canonical source remain preserved. Production plan activation is separate.
